minimum_missing_seam.before: Existing capture returns evidence_run_id and fixed evidence root
minimum_missing_seam.missing: The real existing 06:30 heartbeat executor must invoke its assigned Reader against that fixed evidence root, then invoke an independent Reviewer, save their actual JSON and explicit disposition evidence, and pass those exact paths/identities to register-handoff.
minimum_missing_seam.after: Existing register-handoff -> original import -> owner receipt/available_at -> delivered daily-cycle consumes only admissible reviewed product -> saved dated plan -> ordinary GET/UI
minimum_missing_seam.not_missing: The deterministic import/consumer/late-catchup code already exists and was independently tested in previous delivery; creating another cron or re-importing one product cannot replace external Reader/Reviewer execution.
specific_input_needed_to_write_a_legitim: Original heartbeat task id and unredacted non-secret schedule/command configuration plus its enabled/disabled state
Original executor file/module or supported API method and its imported-path/SHA identity
Original Reader and Reviewer invocation contract: request schema, model/provider reference, output schema/path, task/run linkage, timeout/cancellation/retry/lifecycle
Original prompt/selection-policy contract and identity separation requirements; no new strategy thresholds
One preserved real scheduled invocation receipt with started/finished timestamps and evidence-run linkage; failed receipt is acceptable for diagnosis
minimum_missing_seam.reason_no_synthetic_fallback: Without this actual executor contract, filling semantic JSON, assigning generic SELECTED/WATCH, or claiming a differently named Reviewer from one local model call would create a second producer or invented research evidence.

existing_plan_only_boundary.rule: daily_automation.enabled requires plan_material_refresh_only=true; collection remains false
existing_plan_only_boundary.implication: The daily plan hook deliberately cannot serve as replacement article Reader/Reviewer. Old collector opt-in and 06:30 article research are separate original roles.

earlier_source_followup.finding: Earlier fixed owner import command explicitly says Run this once only and pins one reviewed product; README leaves operator, per-article semantic decisions, owner import and natural daily operation unverified. It adds valid front-end dependency bytes but does not supply heartbeat execution/model contract.

next_code_work_when_original_entry_is_av: Add the smallest continuation in that original heartbeat executor: preserve exact capture run; reader -> separate reviewer -> register/import/readback; durable terminal failures and bounded resume under original lifecycle; then use the already delivered daily owner.
